title: Bead: Protocol (Envelope/Manifest/Chunk/Receipt) + CBOR + deterministic IDs + test vectors
description: Define v1 protocol structs (Envelope/Manifest/Chunk/Receipt), canonical CBOR encoding rules, SHA-256 ID computation, and cross-platform test vectors.

title: Bead: Routing (priorities, manifest-first, round-robin chunks, session budget rules)
description: Implement routing/send-plan policy: receipts first, manifests before chunks, round-robin chunks across messages; session budgeting; unit tests.

title: Bead: Store (SQLite, chunkstore, outbox/inbox/cargo, TTL + eviction)
description: Implement SQLite persistence: envelopes/manifests/chunks/receipts; outbox/inbox/cargo states; dedup by IDs; TTL + eviction; integration tests.

title: Protocol: stub Swift types + ID helpers to unblock other beads
description: Create initial Swift structs for EnvelopeV1/ManifestV1/ChunkV1/ReceiptV1 and SHA-256 ID helper functions. Encoding can be stubbed; focus is compile-able APIs and deterministic ID inputs.

title: Bead: Identity (Ed25519 keypair, secure storage, fingerprint, receipt signing)
description: Implement Ed25519 identity generation and secure persistence; expose fingerprint + QR contact card; sign/verify ReceiptV1.

title: Bead: Crypto (seal key to recipient, encrypt/decrypt payload bytes, algorithm metadata)
description: Implement payload encryption/decryption and sealed payload-key for recipient; include algorithm metadata; unit tests for round-trip and wrong-key failure.

title: Bead: Chunking (32KB chunks, manifest build, reassembly, dedup invariants)
description: Implement 32KB chunking, manifest creation, and reassembly; enforce chunkId=sha256(bytes); deterministic tests.

title: Bead: Simulated Link E2E (two nodes, budgeted sessions, eventual delivery)
description: Build an in-memory simulated link between two nodes using existing Store+Routing+Chunking+Protocol. Demonstrate end-to-end delivery of a payload via repeated budgeted sessions. No BLE yet. Include tests proving eventual delivery + idempotency with duplication.

title: Bead: Transport interface (Link/Session/Frame) + Sim adapter
description: Define a transport abstraction for Aethos: Frame type, Link protocol, Session lifecycle, and a SimLink adapter that uses Frame send/recv (not direct store writes). No BLE yet. Add unit tests for deterministic frame send/receive and session budgeting integration.

title: Bead: Wire framing (CargoItem <-> Frame) + partial transfer support
description: Define canonical mapping between CargoItem and Frames, including type discriminators, stable IDs, and partial transfer (multipart) for chunk bytes. Update simulation to use real framing. Add tests: encode/decode vectors + partial reassembly + corruption handling.
